mapper.select: /* AuthMapper.selectLoginHist */ SELECT SEQ, USER_ID, STAT_CD, LOGIN_ORGN, LOGIN_IP, BRWSR_INFO, LOGIN_DATE, LOGIN_DT FROM TB_WB_LOGIN_HIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: /* AuthMapper.insertLoginHist */ INSERT INTO TB_WB_LOGIN_HIST ( SEQ, USER_ID, STAT_CD, LOGIN_ORGN, LOGIN_IP, BRWSR_INFO, LOGIN_DATE, LOGIN_DT, V_USER_ID, ORGN_CD, SESSION_ID, SERVER_INSTANCE ) VALUES ( SQ_WB_LOGIN_HIST.NEXTVAL, NVL(#{userId}, 'NULL'), #{statCd}, #{loginOrgn}, #{loginIp}, #{brwsrInfo}, #{loginDate}, #{loginDt}, #{vUserId}, #{orgnCd}, #{sessionId}, #{serverInstance} )
mapper.select:
/* AuthMapper.getPauseSelfReleaseBlockReason */
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= #{maxSelfCnt} THEN 'REPEAT' ELSE NULL END FROM TB_WB_USER_PAUSE_HIST WHERE UPPER(USER_ID) = UPPER(#{userId}) AND PROC_FG = 'R' AND RESULT_FG = 'Y' AND REMARK = '로그인 화면 본인 숫자확인 해제' AND PROC_DT >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1/24, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
mapper.insert: /* AuthMapper.insertUserPauseReleaseHist */ INSERT INTO TB_WB_USER_PAUSE_HIST ( PAUSE_SEQ, USER_ID, PROC_FG, PROC_DT, PROC_ID , BEF_STAT_FG, AFT_STAT_FG, RESULT_FG , CHK_DAY1, CHK_DAY2, RISK , TODAY_REAL, TODAY_TOT, MIN5_REAL, ME_REAL , LGN_TODAY_TOT, LGN_TODAY_ERR, LGN_MIN5_ERR, LGN_IP_CNT , BLK_TODAY_CNT, BLK_MIN10_CNT, CHK_LAST_IP, CHK_IP_CNT, IP_HIT , COUNTRY_CODE, BLOCK_REASON, SUMMARY_TXT, REMARK , REG_DT, REG_ID, MOD_DT, MOD_ID ) SELECT SEQ_TB_WB_USER_PAUSE_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, 'R', #{procDt}, #{userId} , '50' , CASE WHEN #{updCnt} > 0 THEN '00' ELSE '50' END , CASE WHEN #{updCnt} > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END , H.CHK_DAY1, H.CHK_DAY2, H.RISK , H.TODAY_REAL, H.TODAY_TOT, H.MIN5_REAL, H.ME_REAL , H.LGN_TODAY_TOT, H.LGN_TODAY_ERR, H.LGN_MIN5_ERR, H.LGN_IP_CNT , H.BLK_TODAY_CNT, H.BLK_MIN10_CNT, H.CHK_LAST_IP, H.CHK_IP_CNT, H.IP_HIT , H.COUNTRY_CODE, H.BLOCK_REASON , SUBSTR( '본인 숫자확인 해제 | 접속IP ' || NVL(#{loginIp}, '-') || CASE WHEN H.PROC_DT IS NOT NULL THEN ' | 일시정지 ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' (' || H.PROC_ID || ', SEQ ' || H.PAUSE_SEQ || ')' END || ' | 일시정지 비고: ' || SUBSTR(NVL(H.REMARK, '-'), 1, 300) , 1, 2000) , '로그인 화면 본인 숫자확인 해제' , #{procDt}, #{userId}, #{procDt}, #{userId} FROM DUAL D LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT X.* FROM TB_WB_USER_PAUSE_HIST X WHERE X.PAUSE_SEQ = ( SELECT MAX(Y.PAUSE_SEQ) FROM TB_WB_USER_PAUSE_HIST Y WHERE UPPER(Y.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{userId}) AND Y.PROC_FG = 'P' AND Y.RESULT_FG = 'Y' ) ) H ON 1 = 1
